a: Adapter converts one interface into another clients expect.
Decorator adds behavior to objects dynamically without changing their class.
Strategy swaps algorithms behind a common interface.
Command encapsulates a request as an object (undo, queues, logging).
Template Method defines an algorithm skeleton with overridable steps.
Proxy controls access to another object (lazy load, access control, remote).
Builder constructs complex objects step by step.
Facade provides a simple interface to a complex subsystem.
Iterator provides sequential access without exposing underlying representation.
State lets an object change behavior when its internal state changes.
